title: Sable and the Postcard
author: Lena Crane
blurb: August Ravensworth, a cellist recovering from one catastrophic final performance, keeps love in the past tense where it belongs. But when a lost letter surfaces, postmarked eleven years ago, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must risk the whole heart instead of lending pieces, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
